map.：实性结节 6mm→2 类，12 月低剂量 CT 随访。: : a 6 mm solid nodule -> category 2, low-dose CT follow-up in 12 months.
map.：部分实性成分>10mm→4A/4B 类，建议 3 月复查或 PET-CT/活检: : part-solid component over 10 mm -> category 4A/4B, with a 3-month recheck or PET-CT / biopsy recommended.
map.4 类为可疑恶性需积极处理，并非确诊；最终靠病理。: Category 4 means suspicious for malignancy and needs active management, not a diagnosis; pathology is the final word.
map.按类别 3–12 月不等，新发/增大提示升级。: By category 3 to 12 months, with new or growing nodules prompting escalation.
